card.name: Drug names in compatibility lists
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that follows another drug name in a long unpunctuated list of injectable drugs. It also fires on spaces and digits inside numeric tables.

modes.label: Drug list starts
modes.description: The start of the next drug name in a run of injectable drug names with salts such as HCl or sulfate.
modes.example: Mechlorethamine HCl<< Chlor>>promazine HCl Meperidine H

modes.label: Number tables
modes.description: A space or digit in a dense table of decimal numbers.

card.plain: It marks the point in a long list of injectable drug names, or a table of numbers, where the next item begins.
evidence: Mechlorethamine HCl<< Chlor>>promazine HCl Meperidine H
